title: 受
teacherNotes: Release verified and merged L288 from origin/codex/l288-complete-package against latest origin/main. Dependencies are satisfied in playable order through L289; R001-R016 are already shipped.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: Release verified against production JSON through L288.
usageNotes: Approved display text and Stage 4 option text must stay inside the allowed boundary.
Do not introduce unlearned display characters.
The lesson includes mild injury, wound, foot pain, and headache scenes. Keep every scene preschool-safe: small injury or discomfort only, no gore, no severe injury, and no medical horror.
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for every sentence image.
Use L058 images only as illustration style anchors, not as character appearance references.
Use protagonist family continuity from L154/L162/L163 for the little girl and mother.
Every human prompt must explicitly name the role identity.
No visible text, letters, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, brands, wall writing, or readable marks.
Final images must be WebP, compressed for mobile, longest edge no more than 1024px, target no more than 250 KB, hard limit no more than 400 KB.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate charAudio for 受 as public/assets/lessons/L288/audio/char-u53d7.m4a from the single character.
Generate G02 prefix/suffix audio from exact fragment text around the target character.
Generate G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-sentence audio from exact wrong text.
Do not splice, cut, mute, patch, or extract production audio.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩坐著，腳有一點小傷或扭到的樣子，表情覺得很痛，主角媽媽在旁邊關心。畫面重點是腳受傷、痛得受不了；不可血腥，不可有文字、數字、標籤。

approvedSentences.text: 傷口破皮又進水，真不好受。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 傷口破皮又進水真不好受
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩洗手時，手上的小傷口破皮又進水，表情很不舒服，主角媽媽在旁邊關心。畫面要清楚呈現傷口破皮、進水、覺得不好受；不可血腥，不可有文字、數字、標籤。
主角小女孩躺在床上或坐在床邊，因為頭痛睡不著，表情難受，主角媽媽在旁邊安靜陪伴。畫面要清楚呈現頭痛、不能睡、很難受；不可有藥品文字、數字、標籤。
主角小女孩試穿太小的皮鞋，腳看起來不舒服，主角媽媽在旁邊關心。畫面要清楚表現皮鞋太小、穿了腳痛；不可血腥，不可有文字、數字、標籤。
主角小女孩在室內靠近窗邊，窗外大風吹動樹葉，風聲很大，她用手摀耳朵，表情覺得受不了。畫面要清楚呈現風聲太大、覺得受不了；不可有文字、數字、標籤。

stage4Plan.reason: 「受不了」是本課核心口語用法，目標字清楚。
